body.heading: Where in the world is Cuba?
paragraphs: Cuba is a country in Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Cuba is Havana.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Cuba is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Cuba is the Cuban peso.

body.heading: How big is Cuba?
paragraphs: Cuba covers about 110,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Costa Rica.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Old Havana is a living museum of Spanish colonial squares, fortresses and classic 1950s cars cruising the Malecón sea wall.
Viñales' green valley is dotted with mogotes — steep limestone hills — and tobacco farms where families ride horses between caves and viewpoints.
